spec.name: brand2-email-reporting
spec.stack: operational — no build. Klaviyo Reporting API (read-only) via the Email operator, using a brand-specific API key; no application code, no deploy.
spec.description: Objective: stand up read-only Klaviyo email reporting for our SECOND brand ("rep 2"). This is a reporting-only project — it reads and summarizes email performance from Klaviyo; it does NOT send, edit templates, change lists/segments, or write any app code. CRITICAL INTEGRATION RULE: this brand uses a DIFFERENT Klaviyo account than our existing email project. Its API key is stored as the environment variable KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 (dummy/placeholder value for now, to be replaced with the real key by the owner). The project MUST authenticate every Klaviyo call with KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 ONLY — NEVER use the default/shared Klaviyo key or the first brand's key for any call in this project. All Klaviyo access is READ-ONLY. Deliver standard email performance reporting (campaigns, flows, list/segment growth, deliverability and engagement metrics — opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, revenue where available). No deploy, no production sites touched.
features: Authenticate to Klaviyo using KLAVIYO_KEY_BRAND2 exclusively (dummy value for now); hard rule to never fall back to the default/shared Klaviyo key
Read-only pull of campaign performance (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, open/click rates, revenue if available)
Read-only pull of flow/lifecycle email performance
List & segment size and growth reporting (read-only)
Deliverability & engagement summary (bounce rate, spam/unsub rate, engaged vs dormant)
Periodic report generation (e.g. weekly/monthly summary) for the second brand only
Clear brand-scoping so brand-2 data is never mixed with the existing email project's brand
